text: How often are container images scanned before deployment?

maturity_signals.mature: Container images are scanned daily before deployment
maturity_signals.partial: Container images are scanned occasionally before deployment
maturity_signals.critical_gap: Container images are never scanned before deployment

text: Is there a formal application catalog in place?

maturity_signals.mature: Yes, a formal application catalog is maintained and kept current
maturity_signals.partial: Yes, but the catalog is incomplete or not regularly updated
maturity_signals.critical_gap: No, there is no application catalog

text: How are vulnerabilities prioritized in the patch management process?

maturity_signals.mature: Vulnerabilities are prioritized by exploitability and asset criticality
maturity_signals.partial: Vulnerabilities are prioritized by CVSS score or asset criticality only

text: Is application security testing part of the development lifecycle?

maturity_signals.mature: Yes, application security testing is integrated into the development lifecycle
maturity_signals.partial: Yes, but application security testing is not consistently embedded in the SDLC
maturity_signals.critical_gap: No, application security testing is not performed

text: What percentage of cloud workloads are covered under endpoint security and patching programs?

maturity_signals.partial: Most workloads are covered, but some are not
maturity_signals.critical_gap: Less than 20% of cloud workloads are covered

text: How often are penetration tests conducted against applications?

maturity_signals.mature: Penetration tests are conducted quarterly or more frequently
maturity_signals.partial: Penetration tests are conducted annually or bi-annually

text: Are third-party and open source components tracked and scanned for vulnerabilities?

maturity_signals.mature: Yes, third-party and open source components are tracked and scanned
maturity_signals.partial: Yes, but tracking and scanning are not consistently performed
maturity_signals.critical_gap: No, third-party and open source components are not tracked or scanned

gap_if_deficient: Lack of tracking and scanning of third-party components

text: What is the average time to remediate critical vulnerabilities in internet-facing applications?
Are APIs inventoried and included in application security testing?

maturity_signals.mature: Yes, APIs are inventoried and included in application security testing
maturity_signals.partial: Yes, but API inventory is incomplete or not regularly updated
maturity_signals.critical_gap: No, APIs are not inventoried or included in application security testing

gap_if_deficient: Lack of API inventory and testing

text: How are end of life applications handled in the application inventory?

maturity_signals.mature: Removed immediately or after a defined period
maturity_signals.partial: Removed after a defined period, but not consistently

gap_if_deficient: Inadequate handling of end of life applications
